menu:10052820:1.text: I must find food for Odi!
menu:10052820:1.source_cn: 我一定要给埃迪找到吃的！

say:1:1523617001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a guard encountered a massive trickfeather on the <style="highlight">highlands beyond the city</style>!

say:2:1523617002:0.text: The guard couldn't reach the bird. Could you go check it out?
say:2:1523617002:0.source_cn: 那只大鸟飞得太高了，卫兵打不到它，实在拿它没办法。你能...

say:1:1523619001:0.text: Nothing here too... What should I do? Odi's been starving for days...
say:1:1523619001:0.source_cn: 这里也没有吃的吗……怎么办，埃迪已经饿了很久了……
say:1:1523619001:0.male: Nothing here too... What should I do? Odi's been starving for days...
say:1:1523619001:0.female: Nothing here too... What should I do? Odi's been starving for days...

say:3:1523619002:1.text: I know, but this is where those huge birds usually show up, and you just scared one off!
say:3:1523619002:1.source_cn: 我知道，这里经常会飞来那种奇怪的大鸟。但是……但是，你...

say:3:1523619002:1.female: I know, but this is where those huge birds usually show up, and you just scared one off!

say:4:1523619004:1.text: Now's my chance to head further out... Maybe I'll come across some food!
say:4:1523619004:1.source_cn: 我可以趁这个机会，再走远一点……走远一点，说不定就能找...
say:4:1523619004:1.male: Now's my chance to head further out... Maybe I'll come across some food!
say:4:1523619004:1.female: Now's my chance to head further out... Maybe I'll come across some food!

say:5:1523619005:1.text: I've had no luck finding food lately... One way or another, I have to get something soon, or Odi won't make it.
say:5:1523619005:1.source_cn: 这段时间，我一直都没找到食物……埃迪已经饿了很久了，我...
say:5:1523619005:1.male: I've had no luck finding food lately... One way or another, I have to get something soon, or Odi won't make it.
say:5:1523619005:1.female: I've had no luck finding food lately... One way or another, I have to get something soon, or Odi won't make it.

say:7:1523619006:1.text: Really? That's nice of you! If you can scare off that bird, you can definitely find food!
say:7:1523619006:1.source_cn: 真的吗，那……那太好了！你那么厉害，一下就把大鸟赶跑了...
say:7:1523619006:1.male: Really? That's nice of you! If you can scare off that bird, you can definitely find food!
say:7:1523619006:1.female: Really? That's nice of you! If you can scare off that bird, you can definitely find food!

say:8:1523619007:1.text: I'll keep searching in this area. Come back here if you find something!
say:8:1523619007:1.source_cn: 那我先在这附近继续找，等你找到吃的之后，就回这里好啦。
say:8:1523619007:1.male: I'll keep searching in this area. Come back here if you find something!
say:8:1523619007:1.female: I'll keep searching in this area. Come back here if you find something!

choice:6:1:2.text: You're not safe on your own.
choice:6:1:2.male: You're not safe on your own.
choice:6:1:2.female: You're not safe on your own.

choice:2:0:1.text: It's dangerous to be out here alone.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 你一个人在野外不安全
choice:2:0:1.male: It's dangerous to be out here alone.
choice:2:0:1.female: It's dangerous to be out here alone.

say:10:1523619003:1.text: I know, but you just chased that huge bird away, so this place's safe now!
say:10:1523619003:1.source_cn: 嗯，我知道。但是，但是你把大鸟赶跑了，现在这里很安全！
say:10:1523619003:1.male: I know, but you just chased that huge bird away, so this place's safe now!
say:10:1523619003:1.female: I know, but you just chased that huge bird away, so this place's safe now!

choice:2:1:2.text: There's no more food around here.
choice:2:1:2.male: There's no more food around here.
choice:2:1:2.female: There's no more food around here.

say:0:1523620001:0.text: I only found these sandstone nuts...
say:0:1523620001:0.source_cn: 这附近实在没什么吃的，只找到了这些荒漠盐津仁……
say:0:1523620001:0.male: I only found these sandstone nuts...
say:0:1523620001:0.female: I only found these sandstone nuts...

say:1:1523620002:0.text: These nuts should be enough, thanks! Let's bring them back to Odi!
say:1:1523620002:0.source_cn: 这些足够埃迪吃啦，谢谢<male>哥哥</male><...
say:1:1523620002:0.male: These nuts should be enough, thanks! Let's bring them back to Odi!
say:1:1523620002:0.female: These nuts should be enough, thanks! Let's bring them back to Odi!

say:2:1523621001:0.text: Come on, Odi! I've found food for you!
say:2:1523621001:0.source_cn: 埃迪，埃迪！快来，我找到食物啦！

say:6:1523621004:1.source_cn: 埃迪不是人，但它是我最好的朋友！

say:7:1523621005:1.text: All the grownups told me to just leave Odi be, but I can't watch it suffer!
say:7:1523621005:1.source_cn: 其他大人都说，没必要给埃迪找吃的……可是我不能看埃迪出事！
say:7:1523621005:1.male: All the grownups told me to just leave Odi be, but I can't watch it suffer!
say:7:1523621005:1.female: All the grownups told me to just leave Odi be, but I can't watch it suffer!

say:8:1523621006:1.text: Thanks for saving Odi! With these nuts, Odi won't be hungry anymore!
say:8:1523621006:1.source_cn: 谢谢你救了埃迪！有了这些吃的，他就不用饿肚子了！
say:8:1523621006:1.male: Thanks for saving Odi! With these nuts, Odi won't be hungry anymore!
say:8:1523621006:1.female: Thanks for saving Odi! With these nuts, Odi won't be hungry anymore!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1523618003:.text: I need to get something for Odi to eat.
